question: Is the RTK linear growth prediction sufficiently scale-independent across the actual BOSS DR12 RSD fitting window that the production compressed single-fsigma8 mapping is internally defensible at the theory-output level?
scope: linear-theory scale-dependence diagnostic only; does not close survey-window, AP, bias, nonlinear-template or full-shape robustness
production_mapping_definition: fsigma8_eff(z)=d sigma8(z)/d ln a using the same dense-z quadratic derivative used by the production BOSS likelihood
comparison_mapping_definition: fsigma8(k,z)=0.5*d ln P(k,z)/d ln a * sigma8(z)

boss_window_provenance.reference: Gil-Marin et al., MNRAS 460 (2016) 4188, BOSS DR12 monopole/quadrupole RSD analysis
boss_window_provenance.note: The cited analysis jointly constrains fsigma8 and AP geometry; these cuts define a conservative physical k-window for this scale-dependence audit, not a new likelihood.

rtk_point.semantics: historical A5 RTK accepted point; still lower than the tested B9-derived RTK neighborhood and retained as current RTK reference while A5 LCDM is being re-frozen

lcdm_control_point.semantics: independently replayed new A5 LCDM seed used only as a scale-independence control, not as a paired-score certificate

metrics.primary: max over z,k of abs(fs8_k/fs8_eff - 1) for RTK
secondary: per-redshift max and RMS relative deviation
peak-to-peak fs8(k,z) spread divided by abs(fs8_eff(z))
same metrics for LCDM as numerical/control baseline
difference between production eff and existing k=0.1 mapping

interpretation_bands_preregistered.STRICT_SUBPERCENT: primary <= 0.01; supports theory-output scale-independence of compressed fsigma8, but B5 survey/nonlinear closure remains open
interpretation_bands_preregistered.PERCENT_LEVEL: 0.01 < primary <= 0.03; scale dependence is non-negligible and requires explicit propagation through survey/full-shape modeling before adequacy can be claimed
interpretation_bands_preregistered.MATERIAL_GT_3_PERCENT: primary > 0.03; compressed single-fsigma8 mapping is not adequate as a stand-alone representation of RTK growth over the BOSS fitting window

three_percent_reference_scope: 3 percent is used only as a modeling-accuracy reference because the cited BOSS mock validation reported fsigma8 recovery below about 3 percent for LOWZ and 2 percent for CMASS at kmax<=0.24 h/Mpc; it is not a statistical confidence threshold.
guard: This gate can close only B5 sub-question (1): linear growth scale-dependence over the BOSS k-window. It cannot by itself validate survey windows, Alcock-Paczynski remapping, nonlinear RSD templates, bias marginalization or full-shape likelihood use.
